implementationGap.gap: Current is single-column form card; artifact is 2-col split with gradient left panel, Logo, headline, copy, GradientRule. Missing left marketing panel.
Current has KPI row + WorkQueueCard grid. Artifact additionally has CreditChart (grouped bar, 3 bars per season) + GHG DataTable (6 rows x 5 cols) + Province DataTable. Missing chart and GHG table.

Current uses card-based ReviewCard list + detail panel. Artifact uses dense DataTable queue (9 cols) + completeness DataTable + photo viewer (4/3 aspect, pipe SVG overlay, GPS badge) + metadata panel + approve/reject with 7 checkbox reasons. No pipe SVG viewer, no completeness table in our evidence page.
Current is list + createFarmer form. Artifact has DataTable (11 cols) + 760px slide-over drawer with gradient header, 5-tab system (แปลง/calc/N/photo/audit). No drawer, no tabs, no CalcTrace.
No /admin/charts route. ChartsScreen (Gauge, Donut, CreditChart, BarSeries, Bubbles, Treemap, GHG DataTable) is entirely unimplemented as a standalone view.

Current is tabbed (รอตรวจ/อนุมัติ/ปฏิเสธ/ทั้งหมด) with API data. Artifact is 2-col split (DataTable + detail panel with metadata list + checklist), uses 4 hardcoded sample rows, includes MockNote. No detail panel, no sample data.

Current is report catalog with download. Artifact additionally has T-VER submission panel (3 ProgressBars + 3 download buttons + locked submit) + selected report detail pane. Missing T-VER progress panel.
Current is basic sponsor list with empty state. Artifact has per-sponsor Section with province area checkboxes + visibility level checkboxes. No sponsor permission UI.

5 tabs exist in both. Artifact permissions is a 15x5 matrix table; ours is Record-based checkbox grid. Constants tab has two DataTable grids in artifact; notifications are toggle rows. Details differ.

Our layout uses route-driven DashboardShell with usePathname. Artifact ConsoleShell is state-driven (nav prop + screen + onNavigate). Shell is the same but the navigation mechanism differs: route-based vs prop-based.
